AUTHOR: Fleuré
TITLE: Automated identification of invasive rabbitfishes in underwater images from the Mediterranean Sea
REGION: Northern Crete (Greece) and Gulf of Lion (France), Mediterranean Sea
SPECIES: Siganus luridus, S. rivulatus, Chromis chromis, Diplodus sargus, D. vulgaris, Sarpa salpa, Sparisoma cretense, Thalassoma pavo (+5 unseen species in test)
DATA: Own remote underwater videos (GoPro on seafloor), EXOFISHMED campaigns 2017, 2019, 2020; 40 training videos, 9 test videos
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'cameras were set up on the sea floor in shallow (1-5 m deep) coastal habitats'; 'varying hydrological conditions (turbidity and light)'
D2: Train: Crete Oct 2019 + France Sep 2019 videos; Test: France Jul 2017/May 2020, Crete Jun 2019 videos
D_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'To ensure that the test of the algorithm was performed independently from the training, the two datasets were built using videos recorded in different locations or seasons'
R_EV: Table 1: test videos from Banyuls 2017-07, Carry le Rouet 2020-05 and Crete 2019-06 vs training Crete 2019-10; no in-domain test performance reported for comparison
C_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'images with a confidence score lower than 0.8 were transferred to an "unsure" class. The recall was computed after removing these "unsure" images.'
E_EV: Sec. 3: 'The average recall was 0.62 among the eight classes'; 'the recall for the class Siganus increased to 0.99 and the precision increased to 0.61' (classification metrics only)
ARCH: ResNet50 image classifier (PyTorch), confidence-based unsure post-processing, image-area cut-off
METR: Recall, precision per class, confusion matrix, TP/FP vs image area, expert time saving
NOTE: Split by different dates/seasons and sites (two Crete test sites are the same sites as training but June vs October; France test sites differ) -> D1 coded 조사일; external per season/site rule (R2 복수) but only external performance reported, so R3=N. D4=Y: explicit independence statement and annotation rule noting individuals rarely on successive frames. Unsure class (conf<0.8) -> C4=Y. Video-level Siganus presence detection mentioned (4 videos) but treated as classification evaluation; E1 coded 없음 (could be argued 점유 -> E_ALL P). E4 크기별 = TP/FP by image area. Test image counts inconsistent (2024 in abstract vs 2159+100). Training used 1250-1256 images per class sampled from 31,285 annotated.
